hero.headline: BUILT FOR RESILIENCE.
hero.subhead: Citizen Science | Public Health | Education | Public Action
hero.body: Achieving Community Tasks Successfully (ACTS) equips Eastside Houston communities with trusted information, practical skills, and resources that turn knowledge into action.

items.title: Air Quality + Data
items.description: Community air-monitoring networks paired with data literacy, so residents can understand and act on what the air is telling us.
items.imageHint: Air monitor installed in the neighborhood

items.title: Family Resilience
items.description: Health screenings, food-security resources, and disaster preparedness support for Eastside Houston families.

items.title: Community Garden + Food Resources
items.description: Gardening classes, hands-on learning, food literacy, and environmental education, plus a directory of food and community resources.

items.title: Youth Development + STEAM
items.description: 4-H, STEAM, and robotics programs that build creative problem-solvers, innovators, critical thinkers, and future leaders.
items.imageHint: Students working on a robotics project

items.title: Resilient Landscapes
items.description: Community beautification and strategic landscaping that reduce stormwater runoff and strengthen community resilience.

items.title: Community Leadership
items.description: Neighborhood Environmental Ambassadors gain the knowledge, communication tools, and civic literacy to lead and advocate.

items.title: Air Quality + Monitoring Map
items.description: Where community air monitoring takes place and what the readings show.

items.title: Community / Environmental Map
items.description: Environmental features and conditions across the Eastside Houston communities ACTS serves.

items.title: Community Resources Map
items.description: Food, health, and community resources available to residents.

donation.headline: HELP BUILD A MORE RESILIENT COMMUNITY.
donation.body: Your support helps ACTS deliver the education, training, and resources that turn knowledge into action for Eastside Houston residents.
